question: Which cryogenic engine was successfully tested by the Indian Space Research Organisation (ISRO) at an uprated 22-tonne thrust level in March 2026?
solution:
The correct answer is __**CE20.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **Indian Space Research Organisation (ISRO)​ successfully conducted a sea-level hot test of the CE20 cryogenic engine at an uprated 22-tonne thrust level on March 10, 2026.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **Thrust Upgrade:** The engine was previously tested at 19 tonnes; the upgrade to **22 tonnes** is designed to increase the payload capacity of the **LVM3** rocket.
 
• **Test Duration:** The engine performed reliably for a duration of **165 seconds** at the ISRO Propulsion Complex (IPRC) in **Mahendragiri**.
 
• **Innovative Tech:** The test validated a **Nozzle Protection System (NPS)**, which prevents vibrations caused by atmospheric pressure during sea-level firing.
 
• **Reliability:** This specific engine has completed a record **20 hot tests**, proving the durability of indigenous turbopump bearings.
 
• **Ignition:** A **Multi-Element Igniter** was utilized to ensure smooth starting of the cryogenic fuel (Liquid Hydrogen and Liquid Oxygen).

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• CE20 Cryogenic Engine__

 __
 
• Developed by the Liquid Propulsion Systems Centre (LPSC), it is the first Indian cryogenic engine to use a **Gas Generator Cycle**. It powers the upper stage of the LVM3.
 
 
 
• LVM3 (Launch Vehicle Mark-III)__
 
 
• Formerly known as GSLV Mk-III, it is ISRO's heaviest launch vehicle, used for launching heavy communication satellites and the upcoming Gaganyaan mission.
